changes: Compact Admin checklist table with filters, pagination, selection, icon labels/tooltips and explicit atomic lifecycle actions
Section recommendations, explicit section acceptance, checkpoint recommendations and custom typed points before draft creation
Adaptive suggestions from standards and the 100 most recent permitted enabled published templates of the same workflow
Unused published templates can unpublish before editing; every template used by saved work remains structurally protected
Disabled templates stop new assignments while retaining saved work and existing project settings
Single-sheet editable XLSX sample with answer/photo requirements, choices, units, help and dropdowns
Reviewed idempotent imports can create drafts or append points to an unused draft with stale-target protection
learning_limits: Library adaptation changes suggestions and their ordering only; there is no model-weight training or automatic technical approval.
Only accessible published enabled templates of the selected workflow contribute; drafts and operational answers do not.
Recommendations are bounded to 100 sections and 3000 candidate points; larger libraries require a more specific standard/import.
One-page format handles simple fields; repeating tables and detailed evidence conditions remain in the advanced format.
